# Serper Web Search provider (`@xiaolizi0v0/dsh-web-search-serper`)

A Cordis bundle that registers a Serper backend into the Harness web capability
seam (`ctx.web`), fo

llowing the shape of the official
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek` provider: `name` / `inject`

/ `Config` /
`apply`, a provider object with `id`, a cheap `available()`, and
`search(request, sign

al)`. It owns only transport and mapping — the model-facing
`web_search` schema stays with `@deepsee

k-ai/dsh-tool-web` — and it also registers
its own `serper_search` tool (see below). The browser hal

f is the settings form the
Plugins page renders for this bundle's row.
## Provider id and selection

- Registers under provider id **`serper`**.
- The patch does **not** pin `searchProvider`. With the

profile's existing
DeepSeek provider also registered and usable, an un-pinned search reports
`WEB_PR
OVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`; to route searches to Serper, add to the profile patch:

`POST https://google.serper.dev/search` with header `X-API-KEY` and body:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`num` follows the caller's `maxResults` when that is smaller than the configured
page size. The seam
enforces the final cap, so `truncated` is never set here.
## Mapping to the seam result

- `organic[]` → `sources[]` (`link` → `url`, `title`, `snippet`, `date` → `publishedAt`),
deduped by

URL.
- `answerBox.answer` / `answerBox.snippet` → the optional provider `content`.
- Redirects are
refused (`redirect: "error"`), as in the official provider.

ult page |

## The plugin's own tool (`serper_search`)

`dsh-tool-web` owns the model-facing `web_search`, and that tool goes through the
seam, so it depend

s on provider selection. `serper_search` calls this plugin's
provider object directly, so it works w
ithout `searchProvider` being configured:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- `query` is required; `type` (`organic` | `news`), `page` (1–10), `maxResults`,
`gl`, and `hl` are

optional and fall back to the plugin settings.
- The tool enforces its own `toolMaxResults` cap and

reports `truncated`.
- Presentation returns the `card: "web"` / `kind: "search"` view, so the Chat t

ool
card matches the official web tools.
- Both paths share one `search()` implementation; the tool

owns schema,
validation, formatting, and presentation only.
## Error codes
| Situation | `WebError` code |

| No key resolves | `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING` |
| Serper rejects the key (HTTP 401/403) | `W

EB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING` |
| Caller cancellation | `WEB_ABORTED` |
| Transport / provider / u
nmappable body | `WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR` (names the endpoint) |
